import os
from google.cloud import speech
from google.cloud.speech import enums
from google.cloud.speech import types

# Initialize the Google Cloud Speech client
speech_client = speech.SpeechClient()

import pyaudio
import time

from speech_client import speech_client

# Stream microphone audio and yield interim transcripts
def stream_microphone():
    p = pyaudio.PyAudio()
    stream = p.open(format=pyaudio.paInt16,
                     channels=1,
                     rate=16000,
                     input=True,
                     frames_per_buffer=1024)
    stream.start_stream()
    while stream.is_active():
        audio_content = stream.read(1024)
        yield audio_content
    stream.stop_stream()
    stream.close()
    p.terminate()

from speech_client import speech_client
from speech_models import create_streaming_request

# Stream audio chunks from an async source
async def stream_chunks():
    for audio_content in stream_microphone():
        yield create_streaming_request(None, audio_content)

from speech_client import speech_client
from speech_models import create_streaming_request
from google.cloud.speech import enums

# Start a streaming recognizer with language and punctuation settings
def stream_with_language(language_code='en-US'):
    config = types.StreamingRecognitionConfig(
        config=types.RecognitionConfig(
            encoding=enums.RecognitionConfig.AudioEncoding.LINEAR16,
            sample_rate_hertz=16000,
            language_code=language_code,
            enable_automatic_punctuation=True),
        interim_results=True)
    for audio_content in stream_microphone():
        request = create_streaming_request(config, audio_content)
        responses = speech_client.streaming_recognize(request)
        partial_results(responses)

from google.cloud import translate

# Translate live captions into another language
def live_caption_translate(text, target_language='es'):
    translate_client = translate.Client()
    result = translate_client.translate(text, target_language=target_language)
    return result['translatedText']

from google.cloud import language
from google.cloud.language import enums
from google.cloud.language import types

# Check live transcript text for unsafe content
def live_caption_safety(text):
    client = language.LanguageServiceClient()
    document = types.Document(content=text, type=enums.Document.Type.PLAIN_TEXT)
    analysis = client.analyze_sentiment(document=document)
    return analysis.document_sentiment.score < -0.2

from gensim.models import Word2Vec

# Embed caption chunks for semantic meeting search
def caption_embedding(text):
    words = text.split()
    model = Word2Vec([words], vector_size=100, window=5, min_count=1, workers=4)
    return model.wv[words[0]]
